name: 662. cc15 TXE-8087 databricks-claude-top-level-cache-usage: a Databricks Claude answer's top-level cache counts reach unified usage and cost
description: TXE-8087. Databricks-hosted Claude endpoints return cache use as top-level usage.cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens next to the OpenAI-shaped counts (docs.databricks.com/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/api-reference, Usage table). The OpenAI chat decoder had no field for either, so the gateway dropped them and priced the request as 12 uncached input tokens. The fixture's Model Serving route (/serving-endpoints/chat/completions on its TLS listener) answers databricks-claude-cache-fixture with 12 uncached prompt tokens, 4,736 read from the cache, 64 written to it and 20 completion tokens, in Anthropic's convention (total_tokens counts everything); no recorded Databricks response exists yet, so the shape follows the docs. The fixture's pricing sheet carries Claude Sonnet's rates for that row: $3/M input, $15/M output, $0.30/M cache read, $3.75/M cache write. 662.1 sends a buffered chat completion and 662.2 a streamed one; both must report the counts under prompt_tokens_details with prompt_tokens 4812, and log $0.0019968.

item.name: 662.1 a buffered Databricks Claude answer reports its cache read and write in unified usage and is logged at $0.0019968 (fixture) - databricks/databricks-claude-cache-fixture

exec: pm.test('the read and the write reach unified usage under prompt_tokens_details', function () {
pm.test('prompt_tokens counts each cached token once, on top of the 12 uncached ones', function () {
pm.test('no top-level Anthropic cache spelling is served back', function () {
// The log row is written by the batching writer, so poll for it. Bounded: ten reads a second apart.
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + requestId, method: 'GET', header: { 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': token } }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('the answer is logged at $0.0019968, the write at the cache-creation rate', function () {
// 12 uncached x $3/M + 4,736 read x $0.30/M + 64 written x $3.75/M + 20 out x $15/M. Dropping the cache counts gives $0.000336.
pm.test('the log row appeared', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + requestId + ' never appeared: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
